assets.title: Court / material study
assets.alt: Original interpretive artwork of a terracotta clay tennis court, cream rib-knit drape, navy plinth and hovering ivory tennis ball.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: large editorial exhibition hero artwork for an independent FILA brand-history overview.
Primary request: an exceptional contemporary art collage combining tennis court geometry, clay, and textile sculpture; visibly an interpretive artwork, not an archival sports photograph or branded product.
Scene/backdrop: a vast warm cream gallery-like space viewed at a slightly oblique aerial angle. A sculptural patch of terracotta-red clay tennis court lies across it, crisp cream court lines cut through the clay, and a flowing piece of ivory rib-knit textile drapes diagonally across the court and over a deep navy geometric plinth. One oversized plain ivory tennis ball hovers above, casting a dramatic long shadow.
Style/medium: tactile museum installation photographed as high-end editorial art, surreal yet materially believable; rich fine grain, paper edges, clay texture and delicate knit detail.
Composition/framing: expansive landscape 16:9. Bold asymmetric shapes and generous breathing room, court geometry dominates lower left, floating ball in upper right, diagonal cloth linking them. Full bleed artwork, visually powerful at oversized scale.
Lighting/mood: raking late-afternoon gallery light, clean hard shadows, restrained monumental calm.
Color palette: cream #f3eedf, deep navy #071f3c, red #bf2f34 and terracotta clay; avoid bright neon.
Materials/textures: rib-knit cotton, dusty red clay, matte painted wood, tactile off-white paper.
Constraints: absolutely no people, writing, numbers, letters, logos, watermarks, labels, signs or branding. No FILA logo. No recognizable historical garment or commercial product. Make an original art installation, not a real claimed FILA artifact.

assets.title: Knit / sculpture study
assets.alt: Original interpretive artwork of an ivory rib-knit sculpture with red and navy stripes and a tennis-racquet shadow.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: vertical artwork for an editorial exhibition about tennis heritage and fashion material.
Primary request: a monumental fashion-material sculpture made from folded ivory rib-knit cloth, with narrow red and navy stripes and a tennis-racquet shadow; original interpretive art, not a branded garment or historical product photo.
Scene/backdrop: warm cream paper-like gallery wall and pale matte floor, a slim off-white rectangular plinth.
Subject: a long generously folded strip of ivory rib-knit cotton rises and curls in a sculptural architectural form on the plinth, like a soft column. Two slender red and navy woven stripes run near one cloth edge. The shadow of a tennis racquet falls diagonally across the backdrop and partly over the sculpture, its oval outline and string grid crisp and elegant; no actual racquet visible.
Style/medium: tactile contemporary sculpture with editorial photographic rendering, sophisticated analog grain and hand-built paper-like set.
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3 image, full sculpture in view with generous cream negative space at top, asymmetrical plinth low in frame, a diagonal navy paper shape intersects from lower right. Focus on folds and material rhythm; a bold elegant exhibition plate.
Lighting/mood: warm raking studio light, strong elongated graphic shadows, meditative and precise.
Color palette: cream #f3eedf and ivory cloth, deep navy #071f3c, a restrained red #bf2f34 stripe.
Materials/textures: densely ribbed cotton, tactile uncoated paper, matte painted wood, subtle film grain.
Constraints: no people, faces, writing, letters, numbers, logos, tags, labels, commercial branding or watermarks. No FILA logo. No known product silhouette or claim of authenticity. This should look like original contemporary interpretive art.
